{{Top|leg}}
'''Checksum''' was a financial record-keeping and auditing [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owned by [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]]. He had the unfortunate duty of reporting a massive loss of profits at the [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] shortly after Zorba regained ownership of the facility from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Zorba responded by knocking him to the floor.
